datasets.title: sentinel_polar (synthetic drone, with ground truth)
datasets.note: The MATLAB repo's dataset25 photos with the dataset_sentinel_gt silhouettes as ground truth. Level cameras on a ring at 10 degree steps.

datasets.title: zebra (real photos, no ground truth)
datasets.note: Real turntable photos (684x461 originals shrunk to 320x216), run through the same camera ring as sentinel_polar: level cameras, 10 degree steps, focal 520 px. There are no silhouettes, so IoU, false positives/negatives and RMS error are not available. Distance, focal, camera height and the initial box are guesses: change them and watch the bold initial outline on the views until it sits just around the zebra in every view.
